answer: Because the timing is logged against the nebula challenge, the dawn audit can replay the tundra history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 64 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 1221 identities would post 3703 proofs and burn roughly 52 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
